accrued_amount.note: Amazon does not disclose a single aggregate legal accrual figure in this filing's contingencies discussion.

reasonably_possible_loss_in_excess_of_ac.note: Amazon states it discloses reasonably possible losses and that for matters without an estimate it cannot determine an amount or range; no aggregate dollar figure is given.

legal_contingencies.verbatim_quote: The outcomes of our legal proceedings and other contingencies are inherently unpredictable, subject to significant uncertainties, and could be material to our operating results and cash flows for a particular period. We evaluate, on a regular basis, developments in our legal proceedings and other contingencies that could affect the amount of liability, including amounts in excess of any previous accruals and reasonably possible losses disclosed, and make adjustments and changes to our accruals and disclosures as appropriate.
